PACK BURST P6p-matrix — matrix.html, the front door for Matt's verdict session (Run C-3 P6). task_id "P6p-matrix".

Inputs (read-only): /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/matrix_index.json (per cell: status, sources, clip version, flags, transcriber disagreements, packet path given relative to cells/ — rewrite it relative to runs/C-3/); /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/P6c-numbers/numbers.json (uniform numbers + definitions); each cell's packet directory /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/<pack_burst>/packet/ (take img/strip.png as the thumbnail); /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/P2p-turnaround/review.html; /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/P5p-gear-idle-S-r1/packet/review.html and /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/P5p-gear-walk-E-r1/packet/review.html; /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/P5p-vfx/review.html; /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/viewer/index.html; /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/godot/project.godot.

Write out/matrix.html — ONE self-contained page that will be placed at runs/C-3/matrix.html, so every link is RELATIVE to runs/C-3/ (e.g. artifacts/P4p-S-walk/packet/review.html, viewer/index.html, godot/README.md); copy each thumbnail into out/thumbs/<cell>.png and reference it as thumbs/<cell>.png. No external resources, no scripts from the web. Layout: (1) title 'Run C-3 — the Keeper matrix (verdict-ready, not the verdict)'; (2) a FRONT PAGE box listing, in this order, exactly these items as bullet points:
   - HALT H-C3-1 (FIRST): Grok returned 402 'usage balance exhausted' after 53 of 56 clips. Ruling R-C3-9 (veto-open) scoped the halt to the Grok stream; Astra work continued on charter fallbacks. Your options: top up and say 'resume grok' / accept the fallbacks / veto R-C3-9.
   - R-C3-1 GEOMETRY FLAG: the C-2 E frame (R-43) was a mirrored body — your question ('isn't the staff in the wrong hand?') was right. This turnaround follows the derived table: on E/SE/NE the staff is in the NEAR hand. Veto-open.
   - GLYPH (R-C3-14): the judge picked glyph A (needle through three strata); ratify or swap.
   - Q75 reading (R-C3-19): a whole-sheet edit re-renders the body (16 / 9 RGB levels of drift); the gear LAYER cut from it at declared regions keeps the motion byte-identical. See the gear packet.
   - Findings: F-C3-1 residual light contour on dark cloth after the clamp matte · F-C3-2 head-pitch proxy misses the first-second head-down · F-C3-3 coherence calls the passed idle 'redrawn' · F-C3-4 the cut tool's staff-tip proxy tracks the hair (explicit sockets used) · F-C3-5 zero-noise settle tolerance (explicit one-shot key poses used).
   - Gates are PROPOSALS: every number is a report; nothing here is a verdict. Your eye rules each cell at C-4.
(3) links row: Turnaround (packet 20) · Gear (idle S, walk E) · VFX · Pixi viewer wheel (viewer/index.html) · Godot stub (open runs/C-3/godot/project.godot in Godot 4.6: arrows/WASD move, Shift run, Space jump, E cast, G gear) · numbers.csv; (4) the MATRIX: a table with rows S SE E NE N NW W SW and columns idle walk run jump cast; each cell = thumbnail linking to its packet, a one-line badge (clip v1/v2; frames@fps), up to 4 small numbers from numbers.json (G6b, G1 max, closure, motion range) with their definitions in a legend below, a red-bordered list of flags and transcriber disagreements (plain words), and for INCOMPLETE cells a grey box with the reason; (5) a legend with every number definition from numbers.json and the sentence 'All numbers are reports against proposed bands; none is a pass or fail.'; (6) a blank 'Matt's verdict' column per row (a text cell reading 'rule at C-4').
Also write out/summary.txt (≤ 12 lines: counts complete/incomplete, the front-page items in one line each). No image_gen. No code beyond the page. No writes outside out/. No web. calls_used 0. BUDGET 12 minutes.
RETURN: receipt task_id "P6p-matrix"; images []; files: out/matrix.html, out/summary.txt, every out/thumbs/* with sha256; status; concerns. Never PASS/FAIL.
